like_for_like_T2_T3_exercised.rule: every ratio pairs two arms on the SAME targets and the SAME factor base (R-7); never a constant
like_for_like_T2_T3_exercised.thresholds_note: T-1 (2^6, 2^9) and F1' (2^3) are the frozen/amended thresholds for m = 5 cells; at other m the ratios are reported without a threshold (implementation reading, disclosed in implementation-v2.md)

S.note: frozen label 'severe non-freeness' names the > side while its test is < 0.5; both sides reported (T-3)

rq.note: frozen label 'severe non-freeness' names the > side while its test is < 0.5; both sides reported (T-3)

S_rescaled.note: frozen label 'severe non-freeness' names the > side while its test is < 0.5; both sides reported (T-3)

F1.applies_to: completed m = 5 EcGFp5-shaped cells only (the aggregate applies the shape)
F1.note: F1 reads D_raw on the rescaled base (raw_u), the like-for-like raw system for arm iii' (R-7); where either arm is not measured the branch cannot fire

F1_prime.applies_to: completed m = 5 EcGFp5-shaped cells only (the aggregate applies the shape)
F1_prime.note: fires when R_ref < 2^3 on a completed m = 5 EcGFp5-shaped cell; timeouts and memory exhaustion fire neither branch

package.label: F-1..F-3 fixture, n = m = 3, p' = 4111
package.content: curves, beta and 2 regression x_R of square_analogue_n3.json (data only) + 2 fresh seeded known-scalar targets (+ recorded replacements) + >= 2 planted square targets for F-2(b); arms raw_x, raw_u, S3, S3_rescaled, torsion_S3_norm, torsion_S3_rq

predictions.label: PREDICTIONS ONLY (amendment DC-2 P-1..P-5). Never used as a divisor or as a scoring constant.

choosing (beta, lam) per target invalidates the cell
